listing.name: Metroid Prime Hunters (Second Hunt)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Upstream runtime package for Second Hunt; use own game files per documented setup, with upstream/player owning installation and runtime replacement. Observed release artifacts are evidence, not operational package selection or Portcove support. Limits: Upstream only: Upstream claims campaign completion/crossplay. Optional imported Metroid content has separate inputs; no independent campaign/device test here. SecondHunt fork of NoneGiven/MphRead, game-native engine; compare parent existing ownership before standalone issue. Windows/Android beta; original campaign/multiplayer claims attributed. Upstream platforms: Windows x64/Android ARM64 beta runtimes from MphRead C# recreation. Exact OS minimums beyond reviewed docs Unknown. Original data: Own MetroidPrimeHunters NintendoDS USA v1.0 orv1.1, gamecodeAMHE; other regions unsupported. Optional additional content requires own MetroidPrime1/2/3/Trilogy discs or Prime4Beyond Switch files/keys, but these are not required for base Hunters. Exact baseROM hashes/BIOS requirements remain Unknown here. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
